inputs.name: sourceRoot
inputs.description: Repository-relative root of Japanese Markdown source files.

inputs.name: outputRoot
inputs.description: Repository-relative root for mirrored Vietnamese Markdown translations and JSON caches.

inputs.name: glossary
inputs.description: Markdown file containing project terminology and translation rules.

inputs.name: exclude
inputs.description: Repository-relative globs of source documents to leave out of planning and translation.

inputs.name: branches
inputs.description: Branches a person may run this workflow on; also the bases of the batch pull requests.

inputs.name: branchPrefix
inputs.description: Prefix for batch branches, which are named <branchPrefix>/backfill-<batch id>.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Model used by the translation skill.

inputs.name: maxParallel
inputs.description: Translation processes at once; the effective concurrency is the smaller of this and batchSize.

inputs.name: timeoutMinutes
inputs.description: Time limit in minutes for each document's translation, per attempt.

inputs.name: maxTurns
inputs.description: Maximum Claude turns for each document's translation, per attempt.

inputs.name: maxBudgetUsd
inputs.description: Runaway guard in USD (API list price) for each document's translation, per attempt.

inputs.name: maxRepairs
inputs.description: Same-session model repair attempts after a translated document fails checkOutputs; zero keeps the verify-only gate.

inputs.name: allowedTools
inputs.description: Claude tools of the translate step; replaces the whole default list. Keep Read, Glob, Grep, Write, Edit, and Bash(jq empty:*); add only narrow Bash(<command>:*) rules.

inputs.name: maxIterations
inputs.description: Batches per run; at most maxIterations times batchSize documents are attempted.

inputs.name: toolkit
inputs.description: Complete replacement for the default translation, output-check, planner, and finalizer tools.
